name: The Vargas Incident
tagline: One hundred and ninety-three times over three months of construction, and the land took notes.
body:
THE NUMBER IS 193. Over the three months Ghost Haven went up, every single time Belladonna Vargas found a flat surface and bent over it and LOOKED AT HER WIFE, Sera fucked her. Bella maintains the looking is load-bearing. Sera, when asked to confirm, confirms it.

THE SOIL RESPONDS TO INTENTION. Thirty-two girls poured devotion into those beams and the house absorbed all of it, but nobody contributed anything like the Vargases' share. The wood saw looked at what it was being handed and concluded NOW THAT'S AN ASS, and finished the job accordingly. What began as a rectangular timber-frame manor shifted, curved and swelled until the footprint viewed from above was unmistakable.

THE GARAGE FINISHED IN AN HOUR. The concrete cured suspiciously fast, because Sera could not stop long enough to let it cure on its own schedule and the magic did it for them. The girls call the Garage the birthplace of Ghost Haven. The stain on the first bay's back wall is what is left of the argument.

IT IS IN THE CLINICAL RECORD. The Vargas wives replicated the anti-anal-pregnancy result enough times to satisfy any reasonable clinical standard WITHIN THE FIRST YEAR OF THEIR MARRIAGE, and Marianne would prefer not to see it itemised. The only documented dangers are houses being reshaped, Sera's impulse control becoming theoretical, and compression shorts escalating into a matter of civic concern.

IT IS IN THE DOCUMENTATION. The Anti Asshole Pregnancy Clause in the Project Nereid document — the one Marianne reads to you before you ever see the consent menu — carries the Vargas Incident as its worked example. Bella has been infinitely smugger since. She is, by her own accounting and by the architecture, LOAD-BEARING.

THE CHEEKS ARE NOT A NICKNAME. Everyone in this family says the Cheeks, the Thighs, the Ribs so casually that visitors file it as architecture slang. It is a portrait.
rules: 193, over three months, every flat surface on the site
The looking is load-bearing; Bella will die on this
The Garage finished in one hour and the concrete never cured honestly
The stain will never be cleaned. Sealing it only makes it shinier
